parts.text: An IGCSE student is investigating shadows. The apparatus she is using is shown in Fig. 5.1. The object and the screen are square, with dimensions as shown in Fig. 5.1. Fig. 5.1 She places the object at a distance d from the centre of the lamp so that it produces a shadow on the screen. For various values of d , she measures the width w and height h of the shadow and records them in Table 5.1. For each distance d , she calculates a value s , the average side length of the shadow, using her readings for w and h and the equation s = w + h 2 .
